text:
alex: Heads-up — I pushed a proposal for quieting low-signal GPU alerts (reduce mid-night noise). Please read and react.

maria: saw it, will review later :thumbsup:

sam: can you summarize the gating logic? last week we got paged 3 times for tiny GPU memory flares

alex: TL;DR: only page on cluster-level severity or persistent host-level issues. Ticket for transient single-host ones. Proposed rules:

alex: ```yaml
- alert: GPU_Memory_Flare
  expr: sum by(cluster) (gpu_memory_error_count[5m]) / sum by(cluster) (gpu_total_cards) > 0.05
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Cluster GPU memory error rate >5% over 5m"

- alert: GPU_Memory_Sporadic
  expr: increase(gpu_memory_error_count[10m]) > 0
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: "Single-host or very low rate GPU memory events"
```

maria: I like the cluster-level percent threshold. can we add grouping by region and model-type?

alex: yes — group_by: [cluster,region,model_profile]

jordan: what about mute windows? we had noisy autoscaler churn at 03:00

sam: proposal: silence repeat alerts from same host for 15m, auto-ticket on first occurrence, escalate to paging if >3 distinct hosts in 10m or >5% cards affected

kevin: Also add a rollout hysteresis: if we see >2 related host failures in 30m during a rollout label, mark as 'deploy_impact' and page immediately

oncall-bot: reminder: according to current rota, weekend night pages go to sam then jordan

alex: action items:
- alex: create PR with rule changes and grouping -> #infra-alerts
- maria: update runbooks with new escalation steps (ticket -> page thresholds)
- kevin: instrument deploy_impact label in CI
- jordan: add mute-window schedule for autoscaler churn (23:00-06:00 local) and include override

sam: agree. can we monitor false positive rate for 2 weeks and revisit thresholds? :eyes:

alex: yes — add an SLO dashboard panel: 'alert_to_action_fpr' and 'page_count_by_cause'. I'll add to Grafana.

maria: small nit — use lower severity label for ticket rules (severity: minor) so routing picks correct queue

alex: good call. I'll update labels.

jordan: if no objections, I'll merge PR Friday EOD and enable mute window in staging first

kevin: +1

sam: +1

alex: thanks all — good step to reduce noisy 3am pages. closing this thread after PR merged :white_check_mark:
